messages:
nora: quick check-in from the prototype run: added a 2-bit "schema" field in the granule tag so we can switch hint encodings without draining nodes. overview + questions below.

sanjay: nice, how many schemas do we support?

nora: prototype supports 3: 0=legacy-per-page, 1=granule-provenance, 2=handoff-intent. decoder picks layout by schema id.

oleg: runtime cost? extra masking on hot path?

nora: single masked load ((tag >> 6) & 0x3) then fast-switch; measured ~0.5% p50 penalty in tight loops. caching within request context offsets most loads.

ops-bot: note: add alert if mixed-schema confusion > 0.1% reads (metrics to help ops diagnose rollout).

sanjay: what about upgrade safety when schema changes mid-epoch?

nora: we require monotonic schema increase and a compact-fence boolean that nodes honor. compaction clears tags at fence boundary so new schema is safely interpreted. need to document fence propagation delay.

oleg: any plan to compress tags to avoid metadata bloat?

nora: exploring delta-encoding across adjacent granules and a short LZ-lite for long runs. prototype still simple sidecar array; compression is follow-up.

sanjay: ok next steps: write RFC appendix for schema transitions, add the ops alert, and run a mixed-tenancy 48h canary. tagging @oleg for review. :thumbsup:
